key_findings: Allodynia-positive SCI mice had higher intracellular ATP at the lesion site, linked to resting inactivity of dorsal horn neurons; forced ATP production induced allodynia.
Mechanical stimulation released ATP at the lesion, and P2X4 receptor inhibition reduced at-level allodynia after SCI.
